item.title: Amanda Knox and the Murder of Meredith Kercher
item.description: Meredith Kercher, a British exchange student, was stabbed to death in November 2007 in the Perugia, Italy apartment she shared with American student Amanda Knox. The episode follows Knox from Seattle to Via della Pergola 7, through the weeks before the killing and the morning Kercher's body was found. It then traces the court rulings that convicted Knox in 2009, overturned that conviction in 2011 and convicted her again in 2014, leading to the final decision in 2015.

item.title: The Trial and Appeals of Adnan Syed
item.description:
In 1999, high school student Hae Min Lee vanished in Baltimore County and was found dead weeks later in Leakin Park. The investigation centered on her ex-boyfriend, Adnan Syed, and the trial that followed went on to hold the country's attention.
The episode walks through the disappearance, the cell tower evidence, and the testimony that sent Syed to prison, then the appeals, the vacated conviction, and its reinstatement, which have kept the case in the courts for more than twenty years.

item.title: The Touch DNA of JonBenet
item.description:
In 1996, six-year-old JonBenet Ramsey was found dead in the basement of her family's home in Boulder, Colorado. The initial police work was heavily criticized, and early suspicion fell on her parents. Years later, trace DNA found on her clothing pointed to an unidentified male, and in 2008 the district attorney sent the family a letter clearing them.
The episode walks through the timeline of that morning, the grand jury that voted to indict the parents, and the DNA evidence that changed the official account of the case.

item.title: Ted Bundy and the Murder of Kimberly Leach
item.description:
I'm Cory, and this week on CrimeTimeSnacks, we are looking at the devastating timeline of Ted Bundy's crimes and his eventual capture in Florida.
From his early murders in Washington and Utah to his brazen escape from a Colorado jail, Bundy left a trail of terror across the country. He used a fake arm sling and a charming demeanor to lure young women to his Volkswagen Beetle, vanishing them into the night.
But his arrival in Florida in 1978 brought a new level of horror when a twelve-year-old girl disappeared from her school. We'll walk through the timeline, the escapes, and the stolen car in Pensacola that finally brought his cross-country reign to a halt.

item.title: The Zodiac Ciphers
item.description: Between 1968 and 1969, the Zodiac targeted couples on lonely roads and a cab driver in the San Francisco Bay Area, then taunted police and the public with letters, bomb threats, and cryptograms sent to local newspapers. The episode walks through the confirmed timeline: the attacks that left five dead and two wounded, the race to decode the ciphers, and the messages that remained unsolved for over fifty years.

item.description:
Hey everyone, it's Cory. Today we are looking at a case that completely took over the news cycle in late 2002. Laci Peterson was twenty-seven years old and eight months pregnant with her first child when she vanished from her home in Modesto, California, on Christmas Eve.
The search for Laci and her unborn son Conner brought in massive numbers of volunteers and national headlines. We are going to walk through Laci and Scott's early lives, their meeting in college, and the secrets that were hiding just beneath the surface of their seemingly perfect life.

item.title: The Disappearance of Maura Murray
item.description: In 2004, nursing student Maura Murray packed up her dorm room, emailed her professors a fake excuse, and drove north into the White Mountains. She crashed her car on Route 112 and refused a passing driver's offer of help; by the time police arrived minutes later, she was gone. The episode walks through her final days, the decisions she made before leaving, and the online mystery her disappearance became.

item.title: The Doomsday Mom
item.description:
I'm Cory, and today on CrimeTimeSnacks we are looking into the deeply disturbing case of Lori Vallow Daybell and Chad Daybell. What began with the disappearance of two children in Rexburg, Idaho, quickly unraveled into a complex web of extreme fringe beliefs, suspicious deaths, and a sudden flight to Hawaii.
We will trace the timeline of how a religious fiction author and a mother of three crossed paths, forming a small apocalyptic group. From the initial police inquiries to the discovery of a tragic crime scene, we will explore the documented evidence of how doomsday ideologies and financial motives merged into a series of unthinkable acts.

item.title: The BTK Floppy Disk
item.description:
Welcome back to CrimeTimeSnacks, I'm Cory. Today we're looking at one of the most infamous cold cases in American history, the BTK killer. For decades, a phantom haunted Wichita, Kansas, binding and suffocating victims while sending taunting letters to the police and media.
But after going completely silent for thirteen years, the killer made a fatal mistake. He decided to reach out one more time, mailing items to law enforcement that would finally unravel his double life as a family man and security alarm installer. We'll trace the timeline from his chilling childhood fantasies to the digital footprint that brought him down.

item.title: The Murdaugh Family Murders
item.description:
Hey everyone, Cory here. Today we are looking at a case that completely consumed the South Carolina Lowcountry. The Murdaugh family was a legal dynasty, but everything started to unravel on a June night in 2021 when Maggie and Paul Murdaugh were found dead near the dog kennels of their hunting lodge.
Alex Murdaugh told investigators he had been napping at the house and then left to visit his mother, who had dementia. But a video Paul recorded at the kennels, with Alex's voice in the background, told a different story. We are walking through the timeline, the botched crime scene, the 2023 trial, and the 2026 ruling that threw out the murder convictions. Alex Murdaugh is awaiting a new trial, set for April 2027, and is presumed innocent of the murders.

item.title: Elisa Lam and the Cecil Hotel
item.description: Elisa Lam was a Canadian student traveling alone through California when she vanished from a Los Angeles hotel. The only clue left behind was a security video from an elevator, which left millions of people guessing when the case took over the internet in 2013. The episode follows her journey down the coast, her struggles with mental health, her final known movements in downtown LA, and a hotel search restricted by legal limits. It ends with the discovery on the roof, the coroner's final conclusions, and how online sleuths built a mystery around the case.

item.title: The Menendez Brothers: The Parole Years
item.description: What happened to Lyle and Erik Menendez after the verdict: thirty years of appeals that went nowhere, the marriages inside prison walls, the TikTok generation that heard the abuse testimony differently, a letter found in a dresser, and a former Menudo member who came forward in 2023. Then the part that is still moving: one district attorney who asked for resentencing and another who called their defense self-serving lies, the May 2025 ruling that cut their sentences to fifty years to life, the parole board that said no three months later, the judge who refused a new trial, and the early parole hearing now set for March 2027. The murders and the trials are covered in an earlier episode, so this one tells 1989 once and spends its time on everything since.

item.title: The Interrogation of Chris Watts
item.description: The forty-eight hours in which Chris Watts's story came apart on camera, from the welfare check on August 13, 2018 to the oil site at 11 that night two days later. A friend who would not leave a doorstep, a patrol officer who noticed a husband was too calm, a neighbor's security camera, an FBI agent who held back his best evidence, a polygraph score of negative 18, and the way out that investigators offered him. Then the plea, the sentence, and the versions of the story he has told since; where the published accounts disagree, the episode says so.

item.title: Hunting the Golden State Killer
item.description:
For more than forty years, California was haunted by an elusive predator known across decades by different names: the Visalia Ransacker, the East Area Rapist, the Original Night Stalker, and ultimately, the Golden State Killer. Leaving behind dozens of violated homes, traumatized survivors, and shattered families, the attacker seemed to vanish into thin air by the mid-1980s, evading traditional police work and fingerprint databases alike.
In this episode, I walk you through how a predator who once wore a police badge managed to operate in the shadows, and how investigators revolutionized criminal forensics by using genetic genealogy to crack open the coldest trail in California history. We examine the timeline, the evidence, and the long road to unmasking an ordinary retiree living in a quiet suburban neighborhood.

item.title: JonBenét Ramsey Americas Child Beauty Queen
item.description: In Boulder, Colorado, just a day after Christmas in 1996, JonBenét Ramsey, a six-year-old child pageant star, was found dead in her basement. She had been beaten and strangled. That was hours after her parents, John and Patsy, reported her missing, and hours after her mom found a ransom note on a staircase in the house. Nobody has ever been convicted in this case, even 26 years later. This is the lead-in to a two-part special where we go back to Christmas 1996 and look again at all the facts in this case.

item.title: CrimeTimeSnacks: The Delphi Murder Case 2017
item.description: On February 14, 2017, the bodies of Abigail Williams (June 23, 2003 – February 13, 2017) and Liberty German (December 27, 2002 – February 13, 2017) were discovered near the Monon High Bridge Trail. The case has had no prominent suspects until recently. On October 28th police announced they had made an arrest in the case. A 50 year old Delphi Resident was arrested and charged with two felony counts of murder. Listen while we dive into the case starting over 5 years ago in on a beautiful hiking trail.
